policy: Reputable secondary reporting may be staged when primary pollster/publisher evidence has not yet been captured or its linked data workbook cannot yet be parsed. Such records remain quarantined, must disclose their evidence tier, and cannot become model inputs without primary-source reconciliation or an explicit reviewed exception.

records.method: Resolve Strategic Victorian state voting-intention poll; primary methodology capture pending
records.captureNotes: The Conversation reports the full primary composition, fieldwork and sample and identifies The Age/Resolve as the underlying poll; Poll Bludger independently reports the same top lines and sample. Retain as secondary evidence until the primary Resolve/The Age material is captured or a reviewed exception is made.

records.method: online panel; multilevel regression with post-stratification (MRP) across all 88 Victorian Assembly electorates
records.dependencyPolicy: The statewide topline and seat projection are outputs of the same YouGov/Common Threads survey/model family. They must never be counted as independent polling observations. The seat projection is comparison evidence unless separately validated out of sample.
records.captureNotes: YouGov's own Australian Polling Council statement confirms sample 4,003, effective sample 2,901, online-panel recruitment, rim weighting, respondent preferences, questionnaire order and the MRP method. It gives fieldwork as 16 June–9 July, while secondary reporting used 16 June–10 July. The statewide toplines and 39/29/17/3 seat projection remain secondary-reported and in one dependency family; retain quarantine until first-party results are captured and the date discrepancy is reviewed.
records.weighting: rim weighting by age, gender, education, AEC region, household income, 2025 federal vote and 2023 Voice referendum vote
records.questionnaireOrder: Voting intention was asked after demographics and before the later issue and Treaty questions.
records.mrpSpecification: Multilevel model using individual and geographic characteristics, applied to an electorate-level post-stratification frame; electorate estimates reported with 90% credible intervals.

methodologyReconciliation.policy: Preserve the discrepancy explicitly; do not alter the staged fieldwork end or admit the record to the model until reviewed.
